text:
sophia: Heads up — AtlasCare is reporting repeated 503s from their Dedicated pool in us-west-2. Customer is P1, SLA risk. Need cross-team owners and a short workaround timeline.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager opened: AtlasCare-dedicated-503 (incident id: INC-20260318-042). First alert 1709001202.
maya: I can own infra investigation. Kicking off live logs and checking node health.
raj: On the app side I'm seeing a spike in request queueing and a bunch of 502->503 cascades. Possible backend timeouts + retry storms.
emily: Oncall — I'm with maya. ETA for initial triage 15m.
raj: quick log snippet: ```
2026-03-18T02:12:03Z app[worker-7] ERROR request handler timeout (elapsed=12000ms)
2026-03-18T02:12:07Z lb[proxy-2] WARN upstream closed connection prematurely
2026-03-18T02:12:09Z k8s kubelet OOMKilled container=redwood-inference-worker-abc123
```
liam: @sophia can we route AtlasCare to a lower-latency fallback pool or throttle bursts from their tenant until stabilized?
maya: We can add a routing rule to send AtlasCare traffic to fallback-dedicated-2 which has spare capacity. That should take 10-20m if we run the canary rollout.
taylor: I have a hotfix PR that addresses a connection pool leak (PR #4921). Needs an extra review from emily or olivia before we can ship. If merged we still need to roll out across dedicated pools.
emily: I'll review PR #4921 now. If ok I'll approve in 10m.
olivia: Product noted AtlasCare is on an annual reserved contract; we need a short customer-facing note. @product-sam can you draft a 1-paragraph update after we confirm the workaround?
product-sam: Yep — will draft standby. Need expected ETA for fix or mitigation to include.
raj: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) route AtlasCare to fallback-dedicated-2 (owner: maya). 2) throttle their burst rate at the edge for 30m (owner: liam). 3) merge + roll PR #4921 (owner: taylor) for permanent fix.
maya: Executing routing change now: ```
# canary route change
kubectl -n routing apply -f atlascare-fallback-canary.yaml
```
devops-bot: Deployment pipeline started: canary-route-v1 -> rollout 10% -> 100% if healthy. CI checks passed.
emily: Reviewed PR #4921; left one small comment about connection timeout default. If taylor addresses I'll approve.
taylor: Patch pushed for the comment, requesting re-review.
ops-bot: Alert: CPU on pool-gpu-3 dropped from 94% to 62% after routing change. Error rate for AtlasCare 503s down ~80%.
lucidity: (not in thread) — skipping —
raj: Confirming error decrease in logs. Looks promising.
product-sam: Drafted customer note: "We're aware of intermittent 503s impacting AtlasCare; we've routed traffic to a stable fallback and are deploying a targeted fix. Next update in 30 minutes." Sending to legal for a quick read.
sophia: Decision: proceed with routing + throttle now, merge hotfix once approved, monitor for 1h. Owners: maya (routing), liam (edge throttle), taylor (fix), emily (oncall review). ETA initial mitigation 20m, full rollout 2-3 hours.
olivia: Noted — will coordinate postmortem owner and timeline.
ops-bot: Incident updated: mitigation in progress, status=investigating->mitigating.
sophia: Thanks all — ping here for blockers. If anyone needs help call out and we'll roster additional support. :thumbsup:
